b2-24-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Years at the Office
b2-24-01.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks how long you have been working in your office in Budapest. You have been working there for six years.
b2-24-01.prompt: Tell Meg how long you have been working in your office.
cues: Say how long you have been working there
b2-24-01.target: Llevo seis años trabajando en una oficina de Budapest.
b2-24-01.english: I have been working in an office in Budapest for six years.
b2-24-01.canDo: I can say how long something has been going on with llevar, a length of time and a gerund.

b2-24-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Still Studying
b2-24-02.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks if you are still studying, although it is late. You are, and you still have not finished your work.
b2-24-02.prompt: Tell Carlos that you are still studying and that you have not finished your work.
cues: Say that you are still studying
Say that you still have not finished
b2-24-02.target: Sigo estudiando, aunque ya es tarde, y sigo sin terminar mi trabajo.
b2-24-02.english: I am still studying, although it is already late, and I still have not finished my work.
b2-24-02.canDo: I can say that something is still going on with seguir and a gerund, in the present and the past.

b2-24-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Step by Step
b2-24-03.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks how the project at your office is going. It is moving forward little by little, and you understand the work better.
b2-24-03.prompt: Tell Meg how the project is going.
cues: Say that the project is moving forward little by little
Say that you understand the work better
b2-24-03.target: El proyecto va avanzando poco a poco, y yo voy entendiendo mejor el trabajo.
b2-24-03.english: The project is moving forward little by little, and I am coming to understand the work better.
b2-24-03.canDo: I can say that something happens gradually with ir and a gerund.

b2-24-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Looking for a House
b2-24-04.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks why you have not answered his messages. You have been going around Budapest looking for a house.
b2-24-04.prompt: Tell Carlos why you have not answered his messages.
cues: Say that you are going around the city looking for a house
b2-24-04.target: Perdón, es que ando buscando casa por toda la ciudad.
b2-24-04.english: Sorry, it is just that I am going around the whole city looking for a house.
b2-24-04.canDo: I can say that someone is going around doing something, here and there, with andar and a gerund.

b2-24-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Rising Prices
b2-24-05.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks how life in Budapest is lately. Prices have been going up for months.
b2-24-05.prompt: Tell Carlos what has been happening with prices.
cues: Say what has been going up
Say for how long, without counting the time
b2-24-05.target: Los precios vienen subiendo desde hace meses en Budapest.
b2-24-05.english: Prices have been going up for months in Budapest.
b2-24-05.canDo: I can say that something has been developing up to now with venir and a gerund.

b2-24-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Late Letter
b2-24-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks about your week. You have been waiting two weeks for a letter, and it still has not arrived.
b2-24-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg how long you have been waiting for the letter and that it has not arrived.
cues: Say how long you have been waiting
Say that the letter still has not arrived
b2-24-consolidation.target: Llevo dos semanas esperando una carta y sigo sin recibirla.
b2-24-consolidation.english: I have been waiting for a letter for two weeks and I still have not received it.
b2-24-consolidation.canDo: I can tell llevar, seguir, ir, andar and venir with a gerund apart.
